mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy reducing equity discount rates and boosting valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation coefficient is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the same month are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion, defined by strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE), leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns during periods meeting the trigger condition (GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 4.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to strong labor market conditions supporting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of UNRATE with 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation coefficient is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO) above 120 signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns when INDPRO > 120 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a robust housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong consumer spending and economic expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when RSAFS rises > 1% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in the same month are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 195 indicates inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to the risk of monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL > 195 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC of the threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
